scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: There is a damaged image from inside the property.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Another picture that ends before the part we need?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The corner near the service passage may still be recoverable. That is the detail worth restoring.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then work on the doorway. Don't spend our time making the curtains clearer.
